context.text:
More specifically21:

•(S) ≅ p(Prover, V∗erifier) if (S) looks exactly like (Prover, V∗erifier): that is, δ of the two distributions is 0.
•(S) ≅ s(Prover, V∗erifier) if δ of the two distributions is statistically negligible: that is, it is in o(2−n) (n being the size of the input).
•(S) ≅ c(Prover, V∗erifier) if no PPT can discover, with non-negligible probability, [i.e., Ω(2−n)], an element that is in only one of the sample spaces of the two respective distributions; rephrased in lay language: "if no PPT can find Waldo with non-negligible probability, i.e., in Ω(2−n)".
